title: Opening, date and Punch Miller's real name and birth
summary: Interviewer opens the recording at Tulane's library, dates it 20 August 1959; Miller gives his real name as Anis Burton and birth as 10 May 1894.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Let's see, let me check this. Testing one, two, three. Say something. Hello, man. What's your name? Okay, it's going all right. This is an interview recorded in seminar room number two of the Howard Tilton Memorial Library. What's the day's date, Punch? What's the day's date, Punch? Today is the 20th, isn't it? 20th of August, 1959. And what's your full name anyway? We ought to get that on the tape.
My first, my real full name is Anis Burton.
And you're better known as Punch Miller.
Bill has already got that stuff about your name, huh?
Oh, I thought you told him about that on tape.
He said about Punch Miller. I don't know. I don't think I did. No, I didn't tell him about Anis Burton. I'm pretty sure I didn't.
Yeah, well, let me see. Where were you born?
And what year? We've got that down.

Yeah, Oddfellas Day, that's right. You don't have to look over towards the microphone or anything. Don't worry about it. We'll just put it right halfway in between us and we'll just talk like we ordinarily do. How did you get started in the music business?
